title: a memorial, a page anyone can edit
line: the rule takes its subject as an identity (the name, both dates to the day, the burial place and the relatives it lists agreeing with the tree's claims), writes every fact undecided and none accepted; the ten relatives it lists get no card at all, fit or not, and create nobody; reconsider keeps the identity, a withdrawn one is taken again; a re-read carries the decided link and accepts no fact; the owner's accept is an identity too, and his parents fact has nothing to decide since no relative is ever linked through this record; the plan turns each listed relative into a fetch step for their own memorial, on the tree person their name and birth year plainly fit when exactly one does (his wife, his daughter, each under their own cemetery row) and otherwise as a lead on the subject's own plan (his parents, his six siblings), named apart from documents to decide; the gravestone photograph is a fetch step saved under the list's name, brought in by collect, archived tier 1 unparsed, and a reading of it by the model is a card the rule leaves to the owner

expect.why: the rule takes the memorial's subject as an identity on a page anyone can edit; its reason names the day of birth, the day of death, the burial place and the relatives listed
every fact the page types is written undecided, none accepted
a page anyone can edit builds no fact
a memorial's listed relatives are leads, never cards: the matcher writes no proposal for any of the ten personas the page names beside its own subject, fit or not
nobody is created from a relative the page merely lists

steps.say: reconsider keeps the identity; there is nothing else to take

expect.why: no card exists to take: the ten listed relatives were never proposed

steps.say: a card the rule would take is taken by reconsider, recorded as the rule
the page read again while the rule's decision stands: the link carries to the new persona

expect.why: the memorial's subject through the current reading

steps.say: the decision withdrawn after a re-read resets both personas: the decision is about the record, not one reading of it

expect.why: withdrawn, no citation of his is held through an accepted subject persona, the earlier reading's link included

steps.say: the owner gives the identity: an identity still, the facts undecided, every reading's persona linked

expect.why: no relative the page lists is ever accepted through this record, so link_family finds nobody to place him under: his parents fact has nothing to decide, the way a fact the file makes no claim about does
the owner's decision applies to every reading's persona of that name and role on the record

steps.say: the plan turns each listed relative into a fetch step for their own memorial: his wife and his daughter, whom the tree already holds, under their own cemetery row; his parents and his six siblings, whom it does not, as leads on his own plan

expect.why: his two parents and his six siblings fit nobody in the tree by name and birth year
his father, a lead on his own plan, keyed by his father's own memorial id
a sibling the same way, the stated relationship in the rationale
his wife's name and birth year plainly fit the tree's own Charlotte D Lukens, so her lead sits under her own cemetery row, not as a lead on his plan
his daughter, listed under her married name, plainly fits the tree's own Helen Sara Brant the same way
planning the leads writes no card either
his eight leads are not documents to decide, and are counted apart from them
a lead seated under a matched person's own cemetery row is an ordinary fetch, not counted as a lead waiting on them
the fetch list names each parent's and sibling's own memorial page, to save under the memorial's own name
the lead and the tree's own citation of her memorial are the same page, so the fetch list names it once

steps.say: the subject's plan: the one photograph the page types Grave is a fetch step under the cemetery row

expect.why: one fetch step, for the photograph typed Grave, with the image's URL as locator; the family photographs make none
the fetch list names the image and the file to save it under

steps.say: the photograph saved in the browser under that name, into the download folder

expect.why: the entry's link is the step's locator

steps.say: collect brings the saved image in: it reaches its step by the list's name and is not parsed

expect.why: the image reaches its step by the list's name and is not parsed
the file has left the download folder
archived under the gravestone row, an image, tier 1

steps.say: the stone read by the model: a card for the subject the rule leaves to the owner

expect.why: the model's extractor row carries the model named after llm: and the hash of the form's field names, the only prompt there is
a reading of the stone is a kind the rule may take, refused for the true reason: the subject's own name is not yet accepted on this tree, not for who read it

steps.say: the plan settled and the catalog whole
